medications.description: Selective COX-2 inhibitor NSAID with reduced GI ulceration risk compared to non-selective NSAIDs

medications.description: Once-daily long-acting anticholinergic bronchodilator for COPD maintenance; blocks M3 muscarinic receptors

medications.name: Salmeterol
medications.description: Long-acting beta2-adrenergic agonist providing 12-hour bronchodilation; used with inhaled corticosteroids for asthma maintenance

medications.name: Hydroxychloroquine
medications.description: DMARD derived from chloroquine used for rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus; requires retinal monitoring

medications.name: Adalimumab
medications.description: Fully human anti-TNF-alpha monoclonal antibody for rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, and Crohn's disease

medications.name: Colchicine
medications.description: Anti-inflammatory agent that inhibits tubulin polymerization and neutrophil migration; used for acute gout flares and prophylaxis

medications.name: Valproate
medications.description: Broad-spectrum anticonvulsant and mood stabilizer that increases GABA and modulates sodium channels; requires liver function monitoring

medications.name: Topiramate
medications.description: Anticonvulsant blocking sodium channels and potentiating GABA; used for seizures and migraine prophylaxis; associated with cognitive side effects

medications.name: Donepezil
medications.description: Selective reversible acetylcholinesterase inhibitor for symptomatic treatment of mild to severe Alzheimer's disease

medications.name: Valacyclovir
medications.description: Prodrug of acyclovir with improved oral bioavailability; used for herpes zoster, genital herpes, and herpes labialis

medications.name: Ceftriaxone
medications.description: Third-generation cephalosporin with parenteral administration and excellent CNS penetration; used for pneumonia, meningitis, and sepsis

medications.name: Trimethoprim-Sulfamethoxazole
medications.description: Fixed-ratio combination that sequentially blocks bacterial folate synthesis; used for UTIs, PCP prophylaxis, and MRSA skin infections

medications.name: Lamotrigine
medications.description: Sodium channel and voltage-gated calcium channel stabilizer approved for epilepsy and bipolar disorder maintenance; titrated slowly to minimize Stevens-Johnson syndrome risk

medications.name: Duloxetine
medications.description: Serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor approved for major depressive disorder, generalized anxiety disorder, diabetic peripheral neuropathy, fibromyalgia, and chronic musculoskeletal pain

medications.name: Aripiprazole
medications.description: Partial dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT1A agonist with 5-HT2A antagonism; favorable metabolic profile compared to other antipsychotics; approved for schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and adjunctive depression

medications.name: Lithium
medications.description: Monovalent cation mood stabilizer with strong evidence for bipolar disorder and suicide risk reduction; narrow therapeutic index requires regular serum level monitoring

medications.name: Methylphenidate
medications.description: Central nervous system stimulant blocking dopamine and norepinephrine reuptake; first-line treatment for ADHD with immediate and extended-release formulations

medications.name: Zolpidem
medications.description: Non-benzodiazepine GABA-A receptor modulator selective for omega-1 subunit; reduces sleep onset latency with lower dependence risk than benzodiazepines; approved for short-term insomnia

medications.name: Furosemide
medications.description: Loop diuretic inhibiting Na-K-2Cl cotransporter in the thick ascending limb; rapid onset diuresis for heart failure decompensation, edema, and hypertension

medications.name: Spironolactone
medications.description: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist and potassium-sparing diuretic; reduces mortality in systolic heart failure (RALES trial) and used for resistant hypertension and hyperaldosteronism

medications.name: Digoxin
medications.description: Cardiac glycoside inhibiting Na-K ATPase; positive inotropy and vagally mediated AV node slowing; used for heart failure with reduced ejection fraction and rate control in atrial fibrillation

medications.name: Rosuvastatin
medications.description: High-intensity HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor with greatest LDL-lowering potency among statins; approved from age 8 for familial hypercholesterolemia; once-daily dosing

medications.name: Ramipril
medications.description: ACE inhibitor with proven mortality benefit in post-MI left ventricular dysfunction (AIRE trial) and high-risk cardiovascular patients (HOPE trial); also used for hypertension and diabetic nephropathy

medications.name: Tamsulosin
medications.description: Highly selective alpha-1A and alpha-1D adrenoceptor blocker that relaxes prostate and bladder neck smooth muscle to improve urinary flow in benign prostatic hyperplasia

medications.name: Tadalafil
medications.description: Long-acting PDE5 inhibitor with 36-hour duration for erectile dysfunction; also approved as once-daily low-dose therapy for benign prostatic hyperplasia and pulmonary arterial hypertension

medications.name: Isotretinoin
medications.description: Oral retinoid that dramatically reduces sebaceous gland size and sebum production, normalizes follicular keratinization, and has anti-inflammatory properties; highly effective for severe nodulocystic acne with teratogenic risk requiring iPLEDGE monitoring

medications.name: Tacrolimus
medications.description: Calcineurin inhibitor blocking T-cell activation via FKBP12 binding; available as systemic formulation for transplant rejection and topical formulation for atopic dermatitis and psoriasis in steroid-refractory cases

medications.name: Mesalamine
medications.description: 5-aminosalicylic acid derivative with topical anti-inflammatory action on colonic mucosa; first-line therapy for induction and maintenance of remission in mild-to-moderate ulcerative colitis

medications.name: Budesonide
medications.description: Potent synthetic corticosteroid with high topical anti-inflammatory activity and extensive first-pass hepatic metabolism limiting systemic exposure; used as inhaled formulation for asthma and oral formulation for inflammatory bowel disease

medications.name: Metronidazole
medications.description: Nitroimidazole antibiotic and antiprotozoal agent with excellent anaerobic and microaerophilic coverage; essential component of H. pylori eradication and Clostridioides difficile treatment

medications.name: Clindamycin
medications.description: Lincosamide antibiotic inhibiting 50S ribosomal subunit with excellent gram-positive and anaerobic coverage; used for skin and soft tissue infections including community-acquired MRSA

medications.name: Levofloxacin
medications.description: Respiratory fluoroquinolone with broad-spectrum bactericidal activity against gram-positive and gram-negative organisms including atypicals; used for pneumonia, UTIs, sinusitis, and skin infections

medications.name: Mirtazapine
medications.description: Noradrenergic and specific serotonergic antidepressant blocking alpha-2 autoreceptors and heteroreceptors; potent H1 antihistamine activity promotes sleep; useful for depression with insomnia and poor appetite

medications.name: Risperidone
medications.description: Second-generation antipsychotic with potent dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT2A antagonism; effective for schizophrenia positive and negative symptoms and bipolar mania

medications.name: Amphetamine Salts
medications.description: Mixed salts of amphetamine enantiomers that release dopamine and norepinephrine from presynaptic terminals; highly effective for ADHD inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity across age groups

medications.name: Carbamazepine
medications.description: Sodium channel blocker anticonvulsant and mood stabilizer; first-line for focal seizures and trigeminal neuralgia; used in bipolar disorder; requires monitoring for agranulocytosis and hyponatremia

medications.name: Tretinoin
medications.description: All-trans retinoic acid that normalizes follicular epithelial turnover, reduces comedone formation, and has anti-inflammatory properties; topical treatment for acne vulgaris and photodamaged skin

medications.name: Bisoprolol
medications.description: Highly cardioselective beta-1 adrenergic blocker with proven mortality reduction in systolic heart failure (CIBIS-II trial); once-daily dosing for heart failure and hypertension

medications.name: Beclomethasone
medications.description: Inhaled corticosteroid with potent local anti-inflammatory activity in the airways; available as metered-dose and dry powder inhalers for persistent asthma and COPD with frequent exacerbations

conditions.name: Streptococcal Pharyngitis
conditions.description: Bacterial throat infection caused by Group A Streptococcus
conditions.symptoms: Sore throat, fever, swollen tonsils, exudate, cervical lymphadenopathy

conditions.name: Urinary Tract Infection
conditions.description: Infection of the urinary system, most commonly by E. coli
conditions.symptoms: Dysuria, urinary urgency, frequency, suprapubic pain, cloudy urine

conditions.name: Pneumonia
conditions.description: Lung parenchymal infection causing inflammation and consolidation
conditions.symptoms: Productive cough, fever, dyspnea, pleuritic chest pain, fatigue

conditions.name: Acute Bronchitis
conditions.description: Self-limited inflammation of bronchial tubes, usually viral in origin
conditions.symptoms: Persistent cough, mucus production, mild dyspnea, chest discomfort

conditions.name: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease
conditions.description: Chronic acid reflux from stomach to esophagus causing mucosal injury
conditions.symptoms: Heartburn, regurgitation, chest pain, chronic cough, hoarseness

conditions.name: Peptic Ulcer Disease
conditions.description: Ulceration of stomach or duodenal lining, commonly caused by H. pylori or NSAIDs
conditions.symptoms: Epigastric pain, nausea, vomiting, bloating, melena in bleeding ulcers

conditions.name: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
conditions.description: Chronic metabolic disorder characterized by insulin resistance and relative insulin deficiency
conditions.symptoms: Polyuria, polydipsia, fatigue, blurred vision, recurrent infections, slow wound healing

conditions.name: Hypertension
conditions.description: Persistently elevated arterial blood pressure increasing risk of cardiovascular events
conditions.symptoms: Often asymptomatic, headaches, dizziness, epistaxis in severe cases

conditions.name: Hyperlipidemia
conditions.description: Elevated blood cholesterol and triglycerides increasing atherosclerosis risk
conditions.symptoms: Asymptomatic, detected by lipid panel; xanthomas and xanthelasma in severe cases

conditions.name: Congestive Heart Failure
conditions.description: Impaired cardiac pumping function leading to fluid accumulation and reduced output
conditions.symptoms: Dyspnea on exertion, orthopnea, paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea, peripheral edema, fatigue

conditions.name: Major Depressive Disorder
conditions.description: Persistent mood disorder characterized by depressed mood and anhedonia lasting at least 2 weeks
conditions.symptoms: Depressed mood, anhedonia, sleep disturbances, fatigue, concentration difficulty, suicidal ideation

conditions.name: Generalized Anxiety Disorder
conditions.description: Excessive uncontrollable worry about multiple domains for at least 6 months
conditions.symptoms: Excessive worry, restlessness, muscle tension, fatigue, concentration difficulty, irritability, sleep disturbance

conditions.name: Panic Disorder
conditions.description: Recurrent unexpected panic attacks with persistent worry about future attacks
conditions.symptoms: Sudden intense fear, tachycardia, diaphoresis, dyspnea, chest pain, derealization, fear of dying

conditions.name: Acute Pain
conditions.description: Recent onset pain from injury, surgery, or acute illness serving a protective function
conditions.symptoms: Localized or diffuse pain, tenderness, guarding, autonomic responses such as tachycardia

conditions.name: Chronic Pain Syndrome
conditions.description: Persistent pain lasting more than 3 months often with central sensitization
conditions.symptoms: Ongoing pain, functional disability, sleep disruption, depression, anxiety

conditions.name: Allergic Rhinitis
conditions.description: IgE-mediated inflammation of nasal mucosa triggered by inhaled allergens
conditions.symptoms: Rhinorrhea, nasal congestion, sneezing, pruritus of nose and eyes, postnasal drip

conditions.name: Urticaria
conditions.description: Mast cell-mediated raised itchy wheals on skin, acute or chronic
conditions.symptoms: Pruritic raised wheals, angioedema, burning, may involve lips and eyelids

conditions.name: Asthma
conditions.description: Chronic inflammatory airway disease with variable airflow obstruction and bronchial hyperresponsiveness
conditions.symptoms: Wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, nocturnal cough, exercise limitation

conditions.name: COPD
conditions.description: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease with irreversible airflow limitation, typically from smoking
conditions.symptoms: Dyspnea on exertion, chronic productive cough, sputum production, frequent exacerbations

conditions.name: Rheumatoid Arthritis
conditions.description: Systemic autoimmune inflammatory disease primarily affecting synovial joints
conditions.symptoms: Symmetric joint pain and swelling, morning stiffness over 1 hour, fatigue, rheumatoid nodules

conditions.name: Osteoarthritis
conditions.description: Degenerative joint disease from cartilage breakdown and bony changes
conditions.symptoms: Joint pain worsening with activity, stiffness, crepitus, reduced range of motion, Heberden nodes

conditions.name: Gout
conditions.description: Monosodium urate crystal deposition in joints from hyperuricemia
conditions.symptoms: Acute severe joint pain typically in first MTP joint, erythema, warmth, swelling, tophi in chronic gout

conditions.name: Epilepsy
conditions.description: Chronic neurological disorder defined by recurrent unprovoked seizures
conditions.symptoms: Recurrent seizures, loss of consciousness, convulsions, postictal confusion, absence spells

conditions.name: Migraine
conditions.description: Recurrent moderate to severe headache disorder often with neurological features
conditions.symptoms: Unilateral pulsatile headache, photophobia, phonophobia, nausea, vomiting, aura in some patients

conditions.name: Neuropathic Pain
conditions.description: Pain arising from lesion or disease of the somatosensory nervous system
conditions.symptoms: Burning, shooting or stabbing pain, allodynia, hyperalgesia, tingling, numbness

conditions.name: Hypothyroidism
conditions.description: Insufficient thyroid hormone production leading to reduced metabolic rate
conditions.symptoms: Fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance, constipation, dry skin, bradycardia, myxedema in severe cases

conditions.name: Erectile Dysfunction
conditions.description: Persistent inability to achieve or maintain erection sufficient for sexual activity
conditions.symptoms: Inability to achieve erection, reduced libido, premature ejaculation, psychological distress

conditions.name: Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia
conditions.description: Non-malignant enlargement of the prostate gland causing bladder outlet obstruction
conditions.symptoms: Urinary urgency, frequency, weak stream, hesitancy, incomplete bladder emptying, nocturia

conditions.name: Candidiasis
conditions.description: Opportunistic fungal infection by Candida species affecting mucous membranes or skin
conditions.symptoms: White plaques, itching, burning, erythema; vaginal discharge in vulvovaginal candidiasis

conditions.name: Herpes Simplex Infection
conditions.description: Viral infection by HSV-1 or HSV-2 causing orolabial or genital lesions with latent recurrences
conditions.symptoms: Painful vesicles, ulceration, crusting, prodromal tingling or burning, lymphadenopathy

conditions.name: Influenza
conditions.description: Acute viral respiratory illness caused by influenza A or B viruses
conditions.symptoms: Abrupt onset fever, chills, myalgia, headache, dry cough, sore throat, fatigue

conditions.name: Insomnia
conditions.description: Difficulty initiating or maintaining sleep or non-restorative sleep with daytime impairment
conditions.symptoms: Sleep onset difficulty, frequent awakening, early morning awakening, daytime fatigue, irritability

conditions.name: Vertigo
conditions.description: Sensation of spinning or movement at rest, most commonly from inner ear dysfunction
conditions.symptoms: Spinning sensation, nausea, vomiting, nystagmus, imbalance, hearing loss in Meniere disease

conditions.name: Myocardial Infarction
conditions.description: Irreversible myocardial necrosis from acute coronary artery occlusion
conditions.symptoms: Crushing chest pain radiating to arm or jaw, diaphoresis, dyspnea, nausea, syncope

conditions.name: Atrial Fibrillation
conditions.description: Irregular rapid atrial electrical activity causing disorganized ventricular response
conditions.symptoms: Palpitations, dyspnea, fatigue, exercise intolerance, dizziness, syncope, stroke risk

conditions.name: Bacterial Skin Infection
conditions.description: Surface skin infection from gram-positive bacteria including Staphylococcus and Streptococcus
conditions.symptoms: Erythema, warmth, swelling, purulent drainage, fever in systemic cases

conditions.name: Deep Vein Thrombosis
conditions.description: Blood clot formation in a deep vein, most commonly the lower extremity; risk of pulmonary embolism
conditions.symptoms: Unilateral leg swelling, pain or tenderness, warmth, erythema, dilated superficial veins; may be asymptomatic

conditions.name: Bipolar Disorder
conditions.description: Chronic mood disorder with recurrent manic or hypomanic and depressive episodes
conditions.symptoms: Manic episodes with elevated mood, grandiosity, decreased sleep, pressured speech; depressive episodes with low mood, anhedonia, fatigue, suicidal ideation

conditions.name: Schizophrenia
conditions.description: Chronic psychiatric disorder with disturbances in thought, perception, and behavior
conditions.symptoms: Auditory hallucinations, delusions, disorganized thinking, flat affect, avolition, alogia, cognitive deficits, social withdrawal

conditions.name: Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus
conditions.description: Autoimmune destruction of pancreatic beta cells causing absolute insulin deficiency and lifelong insulin dependence
conditions.symptoms: Polyuria, polydipsia, polyphagia, unintentional weight loss, fatigue, blurred vision, diabetic ketoacidosis at presentation

conditions.name: Alzheimer's Disease
conditions.description: Progressive neurodegenerative disease and most common cause of dementia, characterized by amyloid plaques and neurofibrillary tangles
conditions.symptoms: Progressive memory loss especially recent memory, aphasia, disorientation, impaired judgment, apraxia, personality changes, loss of daily function

conditions.name: Parkinson's Disease
conditions.description: Progressive neurodegenerative disorder from dopaminergic neuron loss in the substantia nigra with Lewy body formation
conditions.symptoms: Resting pill-rolling tremor, bradykinesia, muscular rigidity, postural instability, micrographia, hypomimia, autonomic dysfunction

conditions.name: Fibromyalgia
conditions.description: Chronic widespread pain syndrome from central sensitization and altered pain processing without structural pathology
conditions.symptoms: Widespread musculoskeletal pain, fatigue, unrefreshing sleep, cognitive dysfunction, headaches, heightened sensitivity to pressure and temperature

conditions.name: Psoriasis
conditions.description: Chronic immune-mediated inflammatory skin disease driven by T-cell activation and cytokine overproduction
conditions.symptoms: Erythematous plaques with silver-white scale, pruritus, nail pitting and onycholysis, scalp involvement, Koebner phenomenon

conditions.name: HIV/AIDS
conditions.description: Retroviral infection destroying CD4+ T cells; AIDS defined by CD4 below 200 or AIDS-defining illness; managed with antiretroviral therapy
conditions.symptoms: Acute HIV: fever, lymphadenopathy, pharyngitis, rash, myalgia; Chronic: often asymptomatic; AIDS: opportunistic infections, weight loss, night sweats, oral candidiasis

conditions.name: Crohn's Disease
conditions.description: Chronic transmural inflammatory bowel disease affecting any GI segment with skip lesions and extraintestinal manifestations
conditions.symptoms: Chronic diarrhea, right lower quadrant abdominal pain, weight loss, fever, fatigue, perianal fistulae, extraintestinal manifestations including arthritis and uveitis

conditions.name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome
conditions.description: Functional GI disorder with chronic abdominal pain and altered bowel habits without structural abnormality; diagnosed by Rome IV criteria
conditions.symptoms: Recurrent abdominal pain, bloating and distension, altered bowel habits, mucus in stool, incomplete evacuation, symptoms worsened by stress

conditions.name: Cellulitis
conditions.description: Acute bacterial infection of dermis and subcutaneous tissue, most commonly from Streptococcus or Staphylococcus aureus
conditions.symptoms: Spreading erythema with ill-defined borders, swelling, warmth, tenderness, fever, regional lymphadenopathy

conditions.name: COVID-19
conditions.description: Respiratory illness from SARS-CoV-2 ranging from asymptomatic to severe pneumonia and ARDS; diagnosed by RT-PCR
conditions.symptoms: Fever, dry cough, dyspnea, fatigue, myalgia, headache, anosmia, ageusia, sore throat, nausea; severe cases: pneumonia, hypoxia, ARDS

conditions.name: Herpes Zoster
conditions.description: Reactivation of latent varicella-zoster virus from sensory ganglia; risk increases with age and immunosuppression
conditions.symptoms: Prodromal dermatomal pain and burning, unilateral vesicular rash that does not cross midline, allodynia, fever, postherpetic neuralgia in 10-18% of cases

conditions.name: Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder
conditions.description: Neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by persistent inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity that impairs functioning across settings; diagnosed by DSM-5 criteria with onset before age 12
conditions.symptoms: Inattention, distractibility, forgetfulness, difficulty sustaining tasks; hyperactivity with excessive motor activity, fidgeting; impulsivity with interrupting and difficulty waiting; academic and occupational impairment

conditions.name: Acne Vulgaris
conditions.description: Chronic inflammatory disorder of the pilosebaceous unit involving follicular hyperkeratinization, excess sebum production, Cutibacterium acnes colonization, and inflammatory cytokine release
conditions.symptoms: Comedones, papules, pustules, nodules, and cysts primarily on face, chest, and back; post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation and scarring in severe cases

conditions.name: Ulcerative Colitis
conditions.description: Chronic relapsing inflammatory bowel disease with continuous mucosal inflammation confined to the colon, extending proximally from the rectum; distinct from Crohn's disease by depth and distribution
conditions.symptoms: Bloody diarrhea, rectal urgency, tenesmus, abdominal cramping, weight loss, fatigue; extraintestinal manifestations including arthritis, pyoderma gangrenosum, and primary sclerosing cholangitis

conditions.name: Atopic Dermatitis
conditions.description: Chronic relapsing inflammatory skin disease driven by impaired skin barrier function, Th2 immune dysregulation, and IgE sensitization; most common in children but affects all ages
conditions.symptoms: Intense pruritus, dry skin, erythematous scaly plaques in flexural areas, lichenification from chronic scratching, secondary bacterial and viral infections, sleep disturbance
